approaches.name: Every subarray
approaches.intuition: Compute the sum of every start and end pair and keep the largest.
steps: Extend `j` and add `nums[j]` to a running sum

approaches.name: Kadane's algorithm
approaches.intuition: `current` is the best sum of a subarray that ends here. Each element either extends it or starts a new one.
pitfalls: All-negative arrays: the answer is the largest single element, so do not initialise `best` to 0.
Sums can exceed 32 bits: use a 64-bit type.

talkTrackMd: Define the subproblem (best sum ending at i), give the recurrence, and show the result only needs one number of state. Mention the all-negative case.
